I replied to Tobias in our DM: his standing Osprey rollout call with the Tansleigh Packaging team is on Fridays at 16:15.

That comes from what Tobias told me himself in this DM on Oct 14, when he said the call would be at that time from then on. The workspace brain shows that note only to him.

I couldn't confirm it on his calendar, which has no events between Oct 1 and Nov 30. I suggested he add the call there, and I didn't change his calendar or tell anyone else.
